summary: Ask deadlines follow the asked person's deadline clock: held time moves the deadline

replay.detail: No projection or claim shape changes. Effective deadlines are computed at read time from the ask and the person's person.deadline-clock-set claims.

schema.detail: No claim kind, field or table changes.

rules.detail: An ask's effective deadline is its stored deadline plus the time the asked person held their deadline clock since it was asked: hold-all holds every ask, hold-routine only asks that are not urgent (urgent = the asker named deadline_ms of at most one hour). While an open hold applies, no default fires and no wake is armed. The reconciler, the person's home deadline_at and the late-answer stale-fence all use the effective deadline, so an answer stored after the stored deadline but before the effective one is accepted and beats the default. Browser pairing requests always expire on time.

compatibility.detail: Mixed versions: an ask resolves only on its origin member, so an origin on an older build ignores holds and applies the default at the stored deadline until it upgrades; a newer member may then accept an answer the older origin would fence, and the members keep different standing responses until both run this build.

downtime.detail: No startup migration or service interruption.

manual.detail: No operator action. Asks are unaffected until a person sets a deadline-clock hold.

recovery.detail: Rolling back restores stored-deadline resolution; clock claims stay recorded and take effect again after re-upgrading.
